name: Montevideo Carrasco International Airport (Gral. Cesáreo L. Berisso)

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 07/25, is 3,200 m x 45 m; 01/19 is 2,250 m x 45 m

noise.v: at night (21:00-07:00 local, 00:00-10:00 UTC) take-offs must not overfly the city of Montevideo, except for emergency, traffic or weather; by day each aircraft's noise abatement procedure applies
noise.quote: At night take-offs are not allowed to fly over the city of Montevideo, between 21:00 and 07:00 local time

fuel.v: Jet A-1 (DISA, 24 hours) and Avgas 100; suppliers DISA, NEXZUR S.A., SINATUS S.A.

ppr.v: parking: ask the airport operator's Operations Management before arrival which stand to use; the general aviation parking taxiway is only for aircraft up to 12,500 lb
ppr.quote: Users should in all cases, ask the Operations Management of the airport operator before the arrival of aircraft,

handling.v: ramp services by CANDYSUR SA; airport operator Puerta del Sur S.A.

notes: Read: DINACIA AIP Uruguay AD 2.9 SUMU (English), file of July 2026, pages dated 27 NOV 2025 to 09 JUL 2026 (latest), https://www.dinacia.gub.uy/sites/default/files/aip/2026-07/Ad2-9%20ing.pdf . The night rule is a noise routing rule, not a curfew; no curfew stated, so curfew is missing. No slot or PPR text found. Taxiway C limited to code C up to 36 m span (not an aerodrome size limit). Fire category CAT 09. The final ~18,000 characters of the PDF (charts section) were not read. IATA code not stated in the AIP.
